Sesame is a field crop unlocked at experience level 50.

It is used to make fish skewers, snack mixes, sesame brittle, sesame ice cream, sesame smoothies and rice balls.

Like all crops, they are stored in the silo.

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 270 coin.

Growing sesame

Sesame is grown in fields by planting another sesame (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 4 experience points, and takes 1 hour to mature.

Selling sesame

  • Sesame can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 180 coin for 10 units.

Using sesame

Boat orders

  • Boat orders ask for 16 to 25 sesame per crate, up to a total of 100 per boat.
  • Each unit of sesame gives players 8 coins and 6 experience points in boat orders.

Strategy tips

  • Recipes ask for 1-3 sesame. You want to make sure you always have enough of them in your silo.
